# Oh My Pi RPC 18.13.2 identity

Secret-free identity and per-hop source/tree ledger for `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent` from the qualified `18.12.6` ceiling through official stable `18.13.2`. The npm package inventory records every path and SHA-256 for the ceiling plus the published hops `18.13.0`, `18.13.1`, and `18.13.2`. The hop ledger recomputes complete added, removed, and changed paths and classifies every selected-source change.

`18.12.6` tree digest matches Research 447. `gitHead` is null, so the npm tarball is the artifact authority. GitHub tags corroborate the same versions. No artifact was installed or executed.

The selected tools remain `read`, `grep`, `glob`, `todo`, and `ask`. The 14 selected RPC commands are unchanged. `18.13.2` adds unselected `abort_branch_summary`, `dictation_start`, `dictation_stop`, `navigate_tree`, and `set_label`. Optional `input.secret` and `PromptError.code` `cost_cap` stay unmapped. `mr://` stays inside ambient `read`. `18.13.3` is the synthetic later stable.
